'Ask the Editor' is back!

Join **Mehdi** and **Prem** for a live Q&A on **Monday** at **11am ET, 8am PT,
4pm GMT** to break down the latest news. Subscribers can join the conversation
on [Zeteo.com](https://zeteo.com/), the Substack app, or
[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkOTPxDEOg8).

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)
